name: university-timetable-system
description: Automated University Timetable Management System with constraint-based optimization

scripts.frontend:build: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build: npm run backend:install && npm run frontend:build
scripts.migrate:legacy: echo 'Legacy migration scripts removed. Use npm run migrate:incremental for existing databases.'
scripts.setup: npm run backend:install && cd frontend && npm install
scripts.setup:python: python -m venv backend/venv && echo 'Virtual environment created. Activate it and run: pip install -r requirements.txt'
scripts.reset:db: cd backend && psql -U timetable -d TimeTable -f ../schema.sql && node seed.js
